description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'CompanyStructureDao' for managing 'Subunit' entities within an organizational structure. It contains methods for retrieving, saving, adding, deleting subunits, setting organization name, fetching subunit trees, and getting maximum level of subunits.

classes.name: CompanyStructureDao
classes.description: A DAO class for handling database operations related to organizational subunits, including CRUD operations and hierarchy retrieval.

methods.name: getSubunitById
methods.description: Retrieves a Subunit entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: saveSubunit
methods.description: Persists a given Subunit entity to the database.

methods.name: addSubunit
methods.description: Adds a Subunit as a child to a parent subunit in the organizational hierarchy.

methods.name: deleteSubunit
methods.description: Deletes a given Subunit entity from the hierarchy.

methods.name: setOrganizationName
methods.description: Updates the name of the organization (root level subunit).

methods.name: getSubunitTree
methods.description: Fetches the hierarchical tree of subunits up to a specified depth.

methods.name: getMaxLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum level value among all subunits.
